stemMd: A drug disrupts microtubule assembly during cell division. Which event is most directly impaired?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Separation of chromosomes by the mitotic spindle

options.label: B
options.textMd: Base pairing within a DNA double helix

options.label: C
options.textMd: Formation of hydrogen bonds between water molecules

options.label: D
options.textMd: Formation of peptide bonds inside ribosomes

options.label: E
options.textMd: Osmotic movement of water through a membrane

explanationMd: The mitotic spindle is built from microtubules. It attaches to chromosomes and helps separate them during division. Blocking microtubule assembly therefore directly threatens chromosome segregation, even though the drug may have other cellular effects.

distractorRationale.d: Peptide-bond formation is a ribosomal function, not a direct microtubule function.
distractorRationale.b: Microtubules are not the bonds holding DNA strands together.
distractorRationale.e: Osmosis does not require a mitotic spindle.
distractorRationale.c: These bonds do not depend on microtubules.
